text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You wish to reach for that, correct?
Then why let your shoulders droop so?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If your feelings have not changed,
then I believe your next step should be
to search for the key to success.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
